style_block: Moody late-1980s to early-1990s R&B photography and music video style, evoking an actual teen vocal group album cover and video shoot rather than a modern photo - the image must read unmistakably as the period, not as a timeless or contemporary look. For performance scenes: a dark studio cyclorama backdrop, dramatic colored gel lighting in magenta, cyan and deep blue, visible haze and smoke in the light beams, glossy high-contrast photography with soft film grain. For domestic/relationship scenes: a cluttered late-1980s apartment interior, wood paneling or busy floral or geometric wallpaper, venetian blinds casting hard light-and-shadow stripes across the room, a corded telephone, a bulky CRT television, a cassette answering machine, scattered cassette tapes, warm lamp light against a dim room. Cinematic 16:9 composition, emotionally charged and intimate mood. All people depicted are archetypal, fictionalized, stylized figures representative of the era rather than an exact reproduction or likeness of any real actor, singer, or real named individual or group. No modern cars, no modern architecture, no modern signage or typography, no modern technology, no smartphones, no flat screen displays, no exact photographic likeness of any real person, no watermark, no signature, no extra fingers, no distorted limbs, no text anywhere in the image.

characters.GROUP: a four-member late-1980s R&B vocal group of young men in their late teens to early twenties, stylized and fictionalized rather than exact likenesses of any real people or real group, standing close together in a tight harmonious formation, matching satin bomber jackets or oversized single-breasted blazers with shoulder pads worn over plain tees, high-top fade or short jheri-curl hairstyles, gold rope chains and gold door-knocker earrings
characters.LEAD: the group's lead singer, an archetypal late-1980s young man in his early twenties, stylized and fictionalized rather than an exact likeness of any real person, a high-top fade haircut, a satin bomber jacket worn open over a plain tee, a gold rope chain, an emotionally open and pained expression, always positioned at the center of the group
characters.WOMAN: an archetypal late-1980s young woman in her early twenties, stylized and fictionalized rather than an exact likeness of any real person, big curled and voluminous permed hair, an oversized blazer with shoulder pads or a satin slip dress, gold hoop earrings, an expression caught between love and heartbreak

reference_notes: Second video in the Nostalgic AI Music Videos niche. Originally planned as two intercut threads (a boy-band performance thread plus a couple's-relationship-fraying flashback thread), revised on the user's request to a single couple-only thread throughout - the ten scenes that showed the group performing (7-11, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22) were replaced with additional LEAD-and-WOMAN relationship beats (an intimate embrace, an early-days memory, a happy dance, watching her sleep, a dawn premonition, a hushed argument, letting go of her hand, her picking up the suitcase, his hand falling away, the door closing). The GROUP character entry is kept in this file only as a historical record of the original two-thread design and is unused in the current prompts.json. The thumbnail (a posed album-cover-style group portrait) was approved before this change and intentionally kept as-is, matching the common convention of an artist/group photo as a single's thumbnail even when the video content itself doesn't show them performing.
